{{Quote|I am Cheelru, of the Inner Circle. You should abase yourself.|Cheelru|<ref name="A Plague of Darkness">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness}}</ref>}}
'''Cheelru''' was powerful [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] and a member of the Inner Circle of the [[Wyrd]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] her commitment to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] had driven her insane. She disagreed with the [[Wyrd Mother]] over the use of the [[Ritual of the Power of the Dark]], as this could potentially destroy the [[Ch'hala tree|Ch'hala]], which would end all that the Wyrd stood for. The Mother responded by having Cheelru chained up in a cave and left there to be a future sacrifice. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] encountered her there while they investigated the Wyrd and she told them about the Ritual.
